I can do that — before I act, a quick clarification so I do exactly what you want:

When you say "consolidate the notification threads in the 'Alerts' label," do you want me to:
1. Keep only the most recent message from each notification thread (per subject/sender) and archive the older messages; or
2. Move all messages from each notification thread into a single folder/label (e.g., create a new label "Alerts - Consolidated") without deleting anything; or
3. Permanently delete (trash) older/duplicate notification messages and keep only the latest; or
4. Something else (please describe)?

Also, do you want me to treat threads as “the same” based on exact subject match, or subject + sender, or thread-id grouping in Gmail (i.e., Gmail conversation grouping)?

Once you confirm which option and the matching rule to use, I’ll perform the actions and email you the count of threads I consolidated.
Option 1: Keep only the most recent message from each notification thread (per subject/sender) and archive the older messages. Treat threads as the same based on subject + sender. Thank you!
